caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a long-sleeved jacket or bolero, positioned centrally against a solid black background. The jacket is rendered in a woven pattern with a predominantly light pink or salmon hue, crosshatched with white lines that give it a textured, checkered appearance. The edges of the garment, including the round collar, open front, bottom hem, and the cuffs of the sleeves, are lined with a decorative, scalloped lace trim in an off-white or ivory color. The interior of the jacket at the front opening reveals a lighter, plain section, also bordered with the lace trim. The shape of the jacket suggests it is designed to be worn open at the front, without visible fastenings. The composition fills most of the image space with the lands laid out flat, and the background is unadorned and uniformly dark, providing contrast to the lighter colors of the jacket.
title: Child's Jacket
